title: PR/spec claim 'harness NEVER builds with PP_DEBUG' is contradicted by this diff's own CI PP_DEBUG harness build
evidence:
CI:
+          odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug

PR body (Golden safety AC4):
+**Golden safety (AC4) — three layers:** (1) the overlay file is compile-excluded in
+  every non-PP_DEBUG build — the harness NEVER builds with the define, so
+  its capture path cannot contain a pixel of it;

Spec:
+- **The harness keeps captures clean** (documented in the PR body): harness builds never pass `-define:PP_DEBUG`, so the overlay file is compile-excluded; the overlay is also
  app-loop-only.
detail: The diff itself builds the harness with PP_DEBUG, falsifying the documented layer-1 AC4 invariant. Capture safety now rests only on layers 2-3, but the reviewed claim says otherwise.
recommended_fix: Reword spec and PR body to 'capture runs never use a PP_DEBUG-built harness binary', or document the bin/harness-debug compile-gate exception explicitly.

title: Spec claims per-frame stats compute for the overlay; the code computes per stepped tick only
detail: Compute lives inside the catch-up loop, once per stepped tick; a paused frame re-reads the stored record. The frozen spec's 'per frame' wording could mislead someone into recomputing during pause, breaking overlay-data == stream-data.
recommended_fix: Update the spec to 'computed once per stepped tick; the overlay re-reads the stored record each frame'.

title: demo_destroy comment claims extraction 'from the three inlined copies', but the diff converts only one call site
evidence:
harness/demo.odin:
+// demo_destroy — free a fully-parsed Demo (N5, Perkins r1: the teardown was
+// inlined at three call sites — extracted to one place so the lifetime rules
+// live with the struct).

harness/run.odin:
+	defer demo_destroy(&demo) // N5: the shared teardown (extracted from the
+	// three inlined copies — the lifetime rules live with the struct now)

(run_demo's inline block is the ONLY inline teardown the diff removes; the only other caller is the new overlay_check)
detail: The diff replaces exactly one inline teardown and adds one new caller; the claimed third conversion never appears. Either the count is wrong or an unconverted duplicate teardown remains outside these hunks.
recommended_fix: Convert the remaining inline teardown call sites to demo_destroy, or correct the comment to the actual number of consolidated sites.

title: App stats builder is allocated and header-written unconditionally, but deleted only when stats_live
detail: Without --stats-out, the default-allocated builder holding the header is never deleted. Bounded (header-sized) and process-lifetime, but it violates the delete discipline the file otherwise follows.
recommended_fix: Create the builder and write the header only when stats_live is true, or free it in an else path at exit.
